title: Quadratic inner-function tester
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits. Its quadratic inner-function tester is a nonadaptive Boolean-function tester making four queries, with addresses drawn from the disjoint union of the input positions and the positions of a quadratic PCPP proof; it is obtained by reindexing the verifier for the homogeneous quadratic PCPP associated with the circuit’s quadratic system.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits
caveat: The quadratic system and the reindexing map are not defined in the supplied context.
